verdict.rationale: Temporal's documented interfaces are code-based SDKs, a structured CLI, and a Web UI dashboard for workflow state — there is no evidence of any natural-language command interface, chat-based control, or AI copilot for operating Temporal itself. The AI-related docs (temporal-docs-9, -25, -33, -47) describe using Temporal to orchestrate LLM/agent workflows, not letting users control Temporal via natural language.
